info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v4-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions API facilitates the retrieval of interaction data between various prescriptions. This endpoint allows healthcare professionals to access critical information regarding potential conflicts and side effects associated with patient medications. Typical consumers include pharmacists and healthcare providers who need to ensure patient safety during medication management. By utilizing this API, users can make informed decisions regarding prescription management and enhance patient care.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch interactions related to prescriptions. It provides insights into potential conflicts between prescribed medications, helping to ensure patient safety and optimize treatment plans.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch prescription interaction information. Clients must provide the necessary data in JSON format to retrieve interaction details for prescribed medications.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of prescription interactions.
